summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in LLMs, with Anthropic's model making progress on the Riemann hypothesis and Meta releasing its new Glimmer AI model. Other notable developments include OpenAI's expansion of its Daybreak cybersecurity defense program and NVIDIA's introduction of new open-source models.
insight: The increasing focus on transparency and accountability in AI development is driving innovation, as seen in Anthropic's decision to watermark text generated by its AI models and Spotify's introduction of 'AI Persona' labels for artist profiles.
highlights: Anthropic's unreleased model makes progress on the Riemann hypothesis, a major unsolved problem in mathematics.
Meta releases its new Glimmer AI model, offering a glimpse into Mark Zuckerberg's personal superintelligence vision.
OpenAI expands its Daybreak cybersecurity defense program, introducing a new cyber-trained AI model.
